newsitem.title: USA: US corporations to issue $4.0 bln in debt this wk.
newsitem.headline: US corporations to issue $4.0 bln in debt this wk.

text.p: U.S. corporations are getting set to unload a huge cargo of debt with about $4.0 billion in new straight issues set to come to market this week, dealers said.
"We're in that period...the two weeks before Thanksgiving and the two weeks after...we'll see a load of debt issuance," one high-grade syndicate source said.
A number of holidays on the horizon have prompted issuers to bring debt to market during this one-month window of opportunity while desks are fully staffed and rates remain at favorable levels.
Meanwhile, in upcoming issues this week, ABN Amro Bank NV is expected to set $300 million in AA2/AA-minus rated 30-year debt, sources said.

Royal Bank of Canada is also expected to issue $300 million in 15-year debt. The issue is expected to consist of a fixed maturity for the first 10 years and a floating rate for the remaining five years, via JP Morgan Securities.
Also, Xerox Corp is expected to set $250 million in 20-year debt with a seven-year put option, sources said.
Rubbermaid Inc is also expected to tap the market with a 10-year debt offering via Goldman Sachs & Co.
Goldman Sachs & Co is expected to underwrite a $750 million in two-part debt offering for Millenium America (formerly Hanson America Inc), dealers said.
The first tranche is expected to consist of $500 million in 10-year debt and the second tranche is expected to consist of $250 milllion of a 30-year maturity, dealers added.
In addition, Peoples Bank Corp may tap the market with a $150 million 10-year debt issue via Lehman Brothers.
Also, sources said Simon DeBartolo may tap the market with $200 million in 10-year debt via Merrill Lynch & Co.
Turning to the private placement arena, Newport News Shipbuilding & Dry Dock Co, a unit of Tenneco Inc is expected to price a $400 million two-part debt offering via JP Morgan Securities.
The first tranche is expected to consist of $200 million in 10-year senior notes and the second tranche consist of $200 million in 10-year senior subordinated notes, sources said.
Cable Plus Holdings is expected to issue $150 million in 10-year 144A notes via Goldman Sachs.
Atrium Cos is expected to issue $100 million in 144A 10-year senior subordinated notes via BT Securities, sources said.
Imed Corp is expected to issue $175 million in 144A 10-year senior subordinated notes via Donaldson Lufkin & Jenrette Securities.
Unifi Inc $200 million of a seven-year 144Aa senior notes via Smith Barney.
Eastern Energy Ltd is also expected to issue $300 million in 10-year 144A debt via Merrill Lynch.
In other issues, Smith Barney is expected to underwrite a 30-year deal for TransCanada Pipelines.
Also, WCI Steel is expected to tap the market with a $300 million 10-year senior secured note deal via Donaldson Lufkin & Jenrette Securities.
In the government market, the 30-year U.S. Treasury bond is off 3/32 at 100-13/32 to yield 6.47 percent.
